summary: Updates BGP so that messages may be larger than the 4,096 octets allowed by RFC 4271. The new maximum is 65,535 octets for all messages except OPEN and KEEPALIVE. This is needed as BGP gains new address families and features that need more room.

eli5.summary: A small envelope can only fit so many pages. As more news needed to be sent, this made the envelope bigger so routers can write longer letters to each other.
